editionLabel: Pandasaurus Games English first-printing rules, copyright 2025
location: Setup step 6 and Gameplay, middle panel of the first unnumbered PDF sheet
firstPlayerRule: Whoever used scissors most recently takes the first turn. Continue clockwise.
evidenceNotes: The full first sheet was rendered and inspected. It contains three panels, not three numbered PDF pages. The first-printing identifier is in the publisher-linked filename; copyright 2025 is in the second sheet's credits. The publisher product record links BGG 429020.

editionLabel: Pandasaurus Games licensed English rules, copyright 2024
location: Setup step 8; Turn Sequence, unnumbered PDF pages
firstPlayerRule: The player with the nicest umbrella at home starts. Turns then proceed clockwise.
uncertainty: The rulebook does not define how to judge the nicest umbrella.
evidenceNotes: Both rendered pages were inspected. The starting criterion is separate from the scoring-token setup typo immediately above it. Credits identify Lumberjacks Studio and licensing to Pandasaurus Games, copyright 2024. The publisher product links BGG 402125. The large primary PDF was retrieved completely with a 150 MB bound after exceeding the earlier 60 MB limit.

firstPlayerRule: Choose who plays the Rebellion and who plays the Empire. The Rebellion acts first, choosing two adjacent Districts to target.
clarifications: The rules suggest giving the Rebellion to whoever most recently broke a rule. This is an example for choosing roles, not a mandatory test.
Each round begins with the Rebellion selecting the target Districts and planning an operation before the Empire defends.
evidenceNotes: Rendered setup page 2, gameplay page 5 and the unnumbered back-page summary were inspected. The roles have asymmetric steps; no alternating first-player choice is invented. The publisher product links BGG 387248. Copyright 2023 is in the page 15 credits.

location: Setup step 3, left panel of the second unnumbered PDF sheet
firstPlayerRule: Pick the starting player at random and give them the bag of chips.
evidenceNotes: The rendered second sheet was inspected. It explicitly prescribes random selection; no draw method or subsequent turn direction is invented. Copyright 2023 appears on the first sheet. The publisher product links BGG 366327.

firstPlayerRule: The most recent person to visit the sea starts. Play continues clockwise.
clarifications: The game also supports one player. In that setup, the sole player takes three tiles and four movement tokens.
evidenceNotes: Both rendered pages were inspected, including the one-player setup table. The credits identify copyright 2023, and the publisher product links BGG 362976.

editionLabel: Pandasaurus Games English updated v2 rules, copyright 2023
location: Player Setup step 3; Selection phase; Two-Player and Solo setup
firstPlayerRule: Give the first turn-order token to whoever has the friendliest pet, or choose that player randomly. Assign the remaining tokens clockwise.
officialTieBreak: Random selection is an official alternative to the pet criterion, whether or not there is a tie.
clarifications: The first Selection phase follows the assigned turn-order tokens. Breeding and Research normally happen simultaneously.
With two human players, the automated opponent receives the third turn-order token. In solo play, it receives the second token.
Later rounds may use a different turn order; clockwise order applies to the opening round.
evidenceNotes: All four cited rendered pages were inspected. The publisher filename identifies the updated v2 manual, and the credits on page 33 state copyright 2023. The official product links BGG 368432. The solo opponent's second token makes the human first; it is not selected using the pet criterion.

firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently brewed a cup of tea or coffee gets the first-player marker. Turns proceed clockwise from that player.
clarifications: At the start of the round, everyone rolls their six dice before the individual turns begin.
evidenceNotes: Both cited rendered pages were inspected, including the dice-roll timing before turns. Copyright 2021 appears in the final credits. The publisher product links BGG 332386. The large primary PDF was retrieved completely with a 150 MB bound after exceeding the earlier 60 MB limit.
